channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Delhi Jewellery & Gem Fair Signature 2026 to Host 150+ Exhibitors at Bharat Mandapam from 28 Feb
item.description: DJGF Signature 2026 will take place from 28 February to 2 March at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, bringing together 150+ exhibitors and over 7,000 expected trade buyers.

item.title: Communique India Crafts Immersive ‘Beyond Limits’ Launch for Tata Punch.ev
item.description: Communique India unveiled the Tata Punch.ev through an immersive launch event built around the “Beyond Limits” campaign, featuring a dramatic LED monolith reveal and interactive product zones.

item.title: CAB Experiences Delivers Bharat Pavilion at AI Impact Summit in Delhi Within 10-Day Turnaround
item.description: CAB Experiences delivered the Bharat Pavilion at the AI Impact Summit in Delhi within a 10-day lead time, showcasing India’s grassroots-focused AI initiatives in the presence of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and 22 heads of state.

item.title: Beatit Entertainment Executes Hyundai Branding Across Eight Stadiums for ICC T20 World Cup
item.description: Beatit Entertainment executed end-to-end Hyundai branding across eight stadiums in India and Sri Lanka during the ICC T20 Men’s World Cup, managing planning through on-ground implementation.

item.title: Dainik Bhaskar Group Appoints Abhay Dubey as Chief Brand Marketing
item.description: Dainik Bhaskar Group has appointed Abhay Dubey as Chief Brand Marketing. He joins from Reliance Broadcast Network, where he led regional marketing initiatives and campaign strategy.

item.title: The Gypsy Travel Festival Draws 7,000+ Visitors Over Two Days at Jio World Drive
item.description: The Gypsy Travel Festival drew over 7,000 visitors to Jio World Drive for two days of immersive travel experiences, cultural showcases and business engagement, organisers said.

item.title: Radhika Das to Return to India in 2026 Following Record-Breaking ‘Silence In Sound’ Tour
item.description: Radhika Das will return to India in April 2026 with performances in Indore, Jaipur and Gurugram, following a record-breaking “Silence In Sound” tour that drew 15,000 attendees in New Delhi.

item.title: Novotel Jaipur Convention Centre Hosts Accor South Asia GM’s Conference 2026; Announces ‘Hotel of the Year’ Recognition
item.description: Novotel Jaipur Convention Centre hosted the Accor South Asia GM’s Conference 2026, featuring industry speakers and strategic sessions, and announced its ‘Hotel of the Year’ recognition at the Accor South Asia Hotel Awards 2024.

item.title: Emaar India Appoints Rahul Taneja as Chief Marketing Officer
item.description: Emaar India has appointed Rahul Taneja as Chief Marketing Officer, tasking him with leading brand positioning, project launches and marketing-sales alignment across India.

item.title: Indian Event Leaders Drive Global Touring Conversations at ILMC 38
item.description: The 38th edition of the International Live Music Conference (ILMC) concluded in London from 24 to 27 February 2026, once again bringing together the most influential stakeholders in the global touring and live entertainment ecosystem.
